alex: FYI running a long-chat loadtest against qwen-2.1 (GQA) and KV page count climbs steadily past ~200k tokens. eviction only triggers near 92% mem and we see 10-30ms tail spikes. repro + logs below.

alex: repro command
```
./tools/run_longchat.sh --model qwen-2.1 --mode gqa --threads 16 --tokens 180000 --batch-size 8
```

alex: trimmed runtime tail
```
[2026-03-10T04:12:23Z] KV_ALLOC pages=18432 used=17269 free=1163
[2026-03-10T04:12:28Z] KV_ALLOC pages=20045 used=18801 free=1244
[2026-03-10T04:12:34Z] KV_EVICT delay_ms=26 reason=pressure threshold=92%
[2026-03-10T04:12:35Z] KERNEL_SELECT name=matmul_opt level=1 fallback=true
[2026-03-10T04:12:35Z] KV_REUSE hit_rate=0.13 prev=0.78
```

chris: odd that reuse collapses after kernel fallback. can you dump kernel_select sampling + trace? also which quant?

alex: q4_0 in this run. kernel select samples:
```
step=64000 kernel=matmul_opt selected=false fallback=1 reason=seq_len>8192
step=64000 batcher.coalesce=true prefetch_kv_miss=0.43
step=131000 kernel=matmul_opt selected=true fallback=0 reason=memory_layout_good
```

maria: from MQA microbench: when rope scaling >1.0 we observe slot id wrapping that aliases across slabs, fragmenting free space. mappings differ across models (qwen vs mistral/llama). suspect rope-rescale table bug.

maria: sketch:
```
if (rope_scale > 1.0) {
  slot = (orig_slot * rope_scale) % slab_size  // modulo causes aliasing across slab boundaries
}
```

jordana: modulo aliasing breaks locality. GC compaction expects contiguous frees so it fails to coalesce resulting in high page counts despite available token capacity.

jordana: short mitigation: run compaction after eviction cycles or set `--kv-compact-threshold=64`. also `kvgc --compact-run` periodically helps.

chris: can we reproduce smaller? try qwen-2.1 seq=60k with `--rope-mode=scale_linear` and toggle `--kv-page-size=4096`. also compare mistral-7b-mqa.

alex: reproduces at seq=60k if rope_scale=1.5 with q4_0. with rope_mode=scale_linear growth is much lower.

alex: mini telemetry (60k seq)
```
model=qwen-2.1 rope_scale=1.5 pages=6123 reuse=0.21 evictions=2
model=qwen-2.1 rope_mode=scale_linear pages=1423 reuse=0.71 evictions=0
model=mistral-7b rope_scale=1.5 pages=1480 reuse=0.68 evictions=0
```

maria: matches expectation — mistral mapping avoids wrap. Qwen's variable rope scaling with MQA packing exposes mapping edge.

jordana: batching makes it worse: coalescing variable-length chats leads to parallel prefetches hitting non-contiguous pages, preventing contiguous allocation and confusing eviction order when combined with aliasing.

chris: action items:
- alex: reproduce minimal (seq=60k) and attach flamegraphs
- chris: add kernel_select instrumentation around fallback boundary
- maria: unit test asserting monotonic slot->slab mapping for rope_scale >= 1.0
- jordana: try background kvgc compact as mitigation
